title: Enhancing pH-gradient microscale bipolar interfaces (PMBI) enabled direct methanol hydrogen peroxide fuel cell (DMHPFC) performance under varying operating conditions
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5673-5683
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01042J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kritika Sharma, Shrihari Sankarasubramanian, Zhongyang Wang, Vijay Ramani
The direct methanol hydrogen peroxide fuel cell (DMHPFC) with a pH-gradient microscale bipolar interface (PMBI) achieves a high open circuit voltage of 1.69 V and peak power density of 630 mW cm−2 by optimising an alkaline anode and acidic cathode.
